references.context: Set theory: smallest equivalence relation on Y containing prescribed pairs
Topology: final topology induced by canonical surjection from Y to quotient set

references.disposition: The relation is generated by all prescribed pairs, not necessarily only those pairs without transitive closure.

review_rationale: Read the coequalizer as a topological quotient of Y by the least equivalence relation identifying f(x) with g(x) for all x, with quotient topology; separate the categorical coequalizer property from the quotient equivalence closure.
